name: Dock
author: leonavas
description: The programs open in the current workspace, drawn with their real icons, in the center of the bar.

barWidget.description: Icons for the windows open in the current workspace, in the order they sit on screen. Left click focuses, middle/right closes, the wheel walks the row.

schema.label: Which windows to show
schema.description: "Current workspace" follows the active workspace of the monitor the bar is drawn on.

schema.label: Icon order
schema.description: Screen order follows the layout: swapping windows around (SUPER + SHIFT + arrows) swaps the icons along with them. Open order keeps the sequence the windows were opened in. By application sorts by window class, leaving every icon in the same slot forever.

schema.label: Group windows of the same application
schema.description: A single icon per application, with the window count in the corner. Clicking cycles through them.

schema.label: Name shown on hover
schema.description: A label floating on the free side of the bar - above the icons when the bar is at the bottom. "Off" falls back to the shell's standard tooltip.

schema.label: Mark the focused window
schema.description: A dash on the bar edge under the icon of the focused window.

schema.label: Dim the windows that are not focused
Disappear when the workspace is empty
Right click also closes the window
schema.description: Turn off to leave closing on the middle button only.

schema.label: Manual names per window class
schema.description: A window class → name map, for anything the dock names badly. E.g. {"chrome-web.whatsapp.com__-Default": "WhatsApp"}.

schema.label: Manual icons per window class
schema.description: A window class → icon name or path map, for apps without a .desktop entry. E.g. {"org.omarchy.agent": "omarchy"}.
